entities.description: A person at a customer or a prospect: their title or role there, from when and until when. A contact can be at several; the primary customer is the contact's Customer.
entities.label: Contact at Account
entities.name: AccountContact

entities.description: Something the books are analysed by beyond cost centre and project (a department, a branch, a product line): its values, the accounts that need it on every line, and the value a line takes when it gives none. Every report filters and groups by it.
entities.label: Accounting Dimension
entities.name: AccountingDimension

entities.description: Per-user hourly rates for an activity type; they override the activity type's defaults.
entities.label: Activity Cost
entities.name: ActivityCost

entities.description: Kinds of work time is booked against, with default hourly rates and the service item used to invoice them.
entities.label: Activity Type
entities.name: ActivityType

entities.description: What assignment rules and replies know of an agent: the skills and languages they cover, the working calendar they are on shift by, and the signature their replies end with.
entities.label: Agent Profile
entities.name: AgentProfile

entities.description: Depreciation defaults and accounts shared by similar assets.
entities.label: Asset Category
entities.name: AssetCategory

entities.description: Scrap: submitting writes the asset off. Sell: create the sales invoice; submitting the invoice submits this disposal and books the gain or loss. Depreciation due up to the disposal date is booked first.
entities.label: Asset Disposal
entities.name: AssetDisposal

entities.description: An asset's maintenance plan. Due tasks create a maintenance log and notify their assignee.
entities.label: Asset Maintenance
entities.name: AssetMaintenance

entities.description: One occurrence of a maintenance task. While in progress the asset is in maintenance; submit it completed (or cancelled).
entities.label: Asset Maintenance Log
entities.name: AssetMaintenanceLog

entities.description: Transfer moves assets to another location; Issue hands them to a custodian; Receipt takes them back from their custodian into a location.
entities.label: Asset Movement
entities.name: AssetMovement

entities.description: A pending repair puts the asset out of order. Submit it completed (or cancelled); a capitalized cost moves from where it was booked into the asset's value.
entities.label: Asset Repair
entities.name: AssetRepair

entities.description: Revalues an asset (impairment or revaluation); the remaining depreciation is spread over the rest of its life.
entities.label: Asset Value Adjustment
entities.name: AssetValueAdjustment

entities.description: A physical check: someone saw the asset, or looked and could not find it. Submitting it records the check on the asset; cancelling takes it back.
entities.label: Asset Verification
entities.name: AssetVerification

entities.description: A customer's invoice written off as a bad debt: to the account its reason names, less the tax relief the company's country gives; submitting it is the approval (the workspace's approval policy, when it sets one). A later recovery is booked against it.
entities.label: Bad Debt Write-off
entities.name: BadDebtWriteOff

entities.description: A company's account at a bank, tied to its GL account; statements are imported against it and reconciled.
entities.label: Bank Account
entities.name: BankAccount

entities.description: One line of a bank statement, reconciled against payment entries and journal entries on the bank's GL account.
entities.label: Bank Transaction
entities.name: BankTransaction

entities.description: One live video from a presenter to an audience through the relay. It may be about any record (a lesson, a product, a meeting). Its status is moved only by the app: Scheduled until a presenter starts, Live until a presenter or a manager ends it, or until no presenter has renewed for a while.
entities.label: Broadcast
entities.name: Broadcast

entities.description: A viewing or presenter link of a broadcast. Only the SHA-256 of its secret is kept: the address is shown once, when it is made. Revoking it stops it at once, and nobody can renew with it.
entities.label: Broadcast Link
entities.name: BroadcastLink

entities.description: Annual amounts per income or expense account for a cost center (and its children) or a project, with what happens when purchase orders, material requests or actual expenses would exceed them.
entities.label: Budget
entities.name: Budget

entities.description: What a person does in a deal's decision: decides, influences, uses it, pays or signs.
entities.label: Buying Role
entities.name: BuyingRole

entities.description: Marketing campaigns; amounts are in the company currency.
entities.label: Campaign
entities.name: Campaign

entities.description: A carrier or a multi-carrier service, described as calls: where to ask for rates, buy a label, track and cancel, and where the answer says what.
entities.label: Carrier Connection
entities.name: CarrierConnection

entities.description: Parcels going by a carrier: the rates offered, the one chosen, the label bought and where the goods are.
entities.label: Carrier Shipment
entities.name: CarrierShipment

entities.description: Someone asking for something in the catalog; approved first when the offering needs it, by someone other than who asked.
entities.label: Catalog Request
entities.name: CatalogRequest

entities.description: A time no normal change is scheduled in; emergencies only.
entities.label: Change Freeze
entities.name: ChangeFreeze

entities.description: A change done the same way each time, with its plan, back-out plan and test plan. Once a Change Manager approves it, a change raised from it on a Pre-approved type needs no further approval.
entities.label: Change Template
entities.name: ChangeTemplate

entities.description: A kind of change and the path it takes. Pre-approved: from an approved template it needs no approval. Board: the members of its board decide, N of M. Emergency: a smaller group decides and the change is reviewed afterwards. A workspace adds its own types.
entities.label: Change Type
entities.name: ChangeType

entities.description: A kind of configuration item and the attributes it carries (a router's firmware, a laptop's asset tag). An item of the class holds a value for each attribute it declares, kept as the item's `attributes` and checked against this list when it is saved.
entities.label: Configuration Item Class
entities.name: CiClass

entities.description: Something IT runs, and what it depends on or runs on. Nothing depends on itself, however far round. Discovery tools report what they find; what people keep is theirs.
entities.label: Configuration Item
entities.name: ConfigurationItem

entities.description: A code that unlocks a pricing rule in the web store. Saving a coupon gates its pricing rule on coupons (doc.coupon_rule), so the rule never applies to anything else.
entities.label: Coupon Code
entities.name: CouponCode

entities.description: When CRM reminds people of their work (zero switches a reminder off; each person can also switch each kind off in their notification settings), and what a lead's recent activity adds to its score.
entities.label: CRM Settings
entities.name: CrmSettings

entities.description: Charts, number cards, shortcuts, notes and lists on a 12-column grid, with filters applied to every widget.
entities.label: Dashboard
entities.name: Dashboard

entities.description: A chart over a query, a saved report or a built-in report, placed on dashboards and spaces.
entities.label: Dashboard Chart
entities.name: DashboardChart

entities.description: A reminder for a customer's overdue installments, charging the level's fee and interest to the customer's account.
entities.label: Dunning
entities.name: Dunning

entities.description: Escalation levels for overdue customers - days overdue, fee, yearly interest and the letter to send.
entities.label: Dunning Type
entities.name: DunningType

entities.description: What happens when a ticket's agreement is at risk or breached. Rules fire in order of level, each at most once on a ticket, one per run of the SLA check.
entities.label: Escalation Rule
entities.name: EscalationRule

entities.description: Carries the foreign currency balances (bank, receivables, payables) at the rate of a day, the difference to exchange gain/loss, reversed on the day after.
entities.label: Exchange Revaluation
entities.name: ExchangeRevaluation

entities.description: Another set of books beside the common one, such as IFRS beside local rules or a tax book: its own entries adjust it alone, and it has every entry with no book besides. Assets keep a book's own values in it.
entities.label: Finance Book
entities.name: FinanceBook

entities.description: A person's forecast for a period as it stood on a day, taken by CRM every few days (CRM Settings): the figures from their deals, their submitted call and their manager's, by category. Written by CRM, never by hand.
entities.label: Forecast Snapshot
entities.name: ForecastSnapshot

entities.description: What a person calls for a period, by forecast category: they submit it, their manager may set another figure beside it (both are kept), and the figures can be compared with what was won (the Forecast against Closed report) and week by week (Forecast History).
entities.label: Forecast
entities.name: ForecastSubmission

entities.description: What became of each mail addressed to a support address: a ticket, a message, or why it was not either. Mail held for review waits here.
entities.label: Inbound Mail Log
entities.name: InboundLog

entities.description: Something broken, reported by a caller. Its impact and urgency give its priority through the Priority Matrix, and the priority its response and resolution targets.
entities.label: Incident
entities.name: Incident

entities.description: A kind of incident or request. One with a parent is a subcategory of it.
entities.label: Category
entities.name: ItCategory

entities.description: A change to something IT runs, of a type that sets its path to approval. With the change board on, a normal change is approved by N of the members of a group, an emergency one by a smaller group and reviewed afterwards, and one raised from an approved template by no one; no two approved changes touch one item at once.
entities.label: Change
entities.name: ItChange

entities.description: A team that works incidents and requests, with its lead. An assignee is one of its members.
entities.label: Assignment Group
entities.name: ItGroup

entities.description: An entry on an incident, request, problem or change: a work note for staff only, or a comment its caller sees. Kept in order with its author and time, corrected only by its author soon after, and never deleted by anyone but an administrator.
entities.label: Note
entities.name: ItNote

entities.description: Extra barcodes of an item (pack barcodes, supplier codes). The item's own barcode and item code scan too.
entities.label: Item Barcode
entities.name: ItemBarcode

entities.description: One operation of a work order on a workstation, with the time spent and the quantity completed.
entities.label: Job Card
entities.name: JobCard

entities.description: A journal entry's lines kept to be made again: by hand from a copy, or every period by the upkeep from its start until its end date or its count, as a draft or submitted. Its next date says what is due; the journal entries made from it list what was made.
entities.label: Journal Template
entities.name: JournalTemplate

entities.description: A problem's workaround as the service desk and the portal find it. Made and kept in step with a known error whose workaround is marked visible; the desk may also write one by hand.
entities.label: Known Error
entities.name: KnownError

entities.description: Gives a lead that arrives by itself (from a form, a mail, an integration), or one entered or imported with no owner where the rule says so, to one of its people. Rules are tried in order; the first that matches and has an active person wins.
entities.label: Lead Assignment Rule
entities.name: LeadAssignmentRule

entities.description: Points a lead earns, or loses, when one of its fields holds a value. A lead's score is the sum of the rules it meets, plus points for its recent calls, meetings and emails, which halve as they age (CRM Settings).
entities.label: Lead Scoring Rule
entities.name: LeadScoringRule

entities.description: Where assets are, as a tree (site → building → room). Groups hold other locations, not assets.
entities.label: Location
entities.name: Location

entities.description: Points ledger, posted by sales, returns, cancellations and expiry; read-only.
entities.label: Loyalty Point Entry
entities.name: LoyaltyPointEntry

entities.description: A maintenance contract (AMC): submitting plans the visits; cancelling drops the visits not yet made.
entities.label: Maintenance Schedule
entities.name: MaintenanceSchedule

entities.description: How an annual budget spreads over the calendar months (12 percentages summing to 100); reusable across budgets.
entities.label: Monthly Distribution
entities.name: MonthlyDistribution

entities.description: One number (a count, sum or average) with its change since the previous period and a drill-down to the records.
entities.label: Number Card
entities.name: NumberCard

entities.description: A way of numbering one kind of document, beside the usual one: a tax invoice against a simplified receipt, a branch's own run. A document takes the series it names, else the one its country's rules or the settings give, else the usual one.
entities.label: Numbering Series
entities.name: NumberSeries

entities.description: An invoice still open in the books a company comes from, carried into these: what a customer still owes or the company still owes a supplier, under its own number and due date, in its own currency. A negative amount is an open credit: an advance, a credit note not yet used. One record per invoice, so a spreadsheet imports them; Post Opening Invoices on the company posts them all at once.
entities.label: Opening Invoice
entities.name: OpeningInvoice

entities.description: Money sent back for a web order: goods that came back (a return: the goods go back into stock and the invoice is credited) or an order cancelled before it shipped; or part of a payment of an invoice, as another app decides (a booking's deposit). A person approves it, the gateway the money came through carries it out, and the books follow.
entities.label: Refund
entities.name: OrderRefund

entities.description: A customer's or supplier's unapplied payments, credit notes and journal credits applied to their open invoices; cancelling it opens them again.
entities.label: Payment Allocation
entities.name: PaymentAllocation

entities.description: The value bands a payment's approval reads, in company currency: above each, its step must approve before a payment out is submitted
entities.label: Payment Approval Settings
entities.name: PaymentApprovalSettings

entities.description: Money a gateway took that could not be booked: the request had closed, or the amount changed. It stays open until someone approves a refund, which the gateway carries out, or records how it was settled.
entities.label: Payment Exception
entities.name: PaymentException

entities.description: A cheque, a draft or another instrument a payment was made with: received or issued, deposited, cleared, bounced, cancelled or replaced. Made by the payment; its state moves by its actions.
entities.label: Payment Instrument
entities.name: PaymentInstrument

entities.description: A request to pay a web order (or an invoice). Gateway plugins subscribe to PaymentRequest.submitted, write payment_url with set_gateway_details and confirm with mark_paid or mark_failed.
entities.label: Payment Request
entities.name: PaymentRequest

entities.description: What to pay suppliers in one go: proposed by due date and early-payment discount, adjusted by a person, approved by submitting it (through the workspace's approval policy on Payment Run, when it sets one), then paid with one payment per supplier and remittance advice to each. Making the payments again pays only what is not paid yet.
entities.label: Payment Run
entities.name: PaymentRun

entities.description: Splits an invoice or order into installments with their own due dates and early payment discounts.
entities.label: Payment Terms Template
entities.name: PaymentTermsTemplate

entities.description: Closes a fiscal year - moves every income and expense balance (per cost center) to the closing account and locks the year's periods.
entities.label: Period Closing Voucher
entities.name: PeriodClosingVoucher

entities.description: One person's approval, by their PIN at the till, of one thing another person asked beyond their limits, for one sale or one act in their session. Written by the till's approval request; read-only.
entities.label: POS Approval
entities.name: PosApproval

entities.description: Cash put into or taken out of a drawer during a session (float top-up, petty cash payout, a drop to the safe).
entities.label: POS Cash Movement
entities.name: PosCashMovement

entities.description: Ends a session; submitting it consolidates the session's POS invoices into sales invoices, credit notes and payment settlements.
entities.label: POS Closing Entry
entities.name: PosClosingEntry

entities.description: A sale (or return) at the register. Stock moves on submit; revenue, taxes and payments reach the books when the session closes.
entities.label: POS Invoice
entities.name: PosInvoice

entities.description: A cashier's session at a register, from opening float to closing count.
entities.label: POS Opening Entry
entities.name: PosOpeningEntry

entities.description: A sale made offline that the server priced again with the snapshot its till used and got another total from: the sale stands as the buyer paid it; a person looks at why (a till out of date, a rule the till does not know).
entities.label: Price Difference
entities.name: PosPriceDifference

entities.description: A register (or a group of registers) and its rules.
entities.label: POS Profile
entities.name: PosProfile

entities.description: The reasons a till offers for voiding, returning, opening the drawer without a sale or reprinting. Disable one to stop offering it.
entities.label: POS Reason
entities.name: PosReason

entities.description: A receipt printed again, a gift receipt, or a receipt sent to the buyer: who, when and for which sale. Written by the till's receipt requests; read-only. The address a receipt was sent to is in the message log, not here.
entities.label: Receipt Event
entities.name: PosReceiptEvent

entities.description: How a register takes returns: within how many days of the sale, what a return without a receipt comes back at and is refunded to, the restocking fee by the goods' condition, and how an exchange carries what comes back to what goes out.
entities.label: POS Return Policy
entities.name: PosReturnPolicy

entities.description: What a role may do at the till without someone else approving it. A person with several roles gets the most generous of them; a row naming a register applies there instead of the role's row for every register. A person none of whose roles has a row keeps the register's own discount and price settings (a POS Manager: no limit).
entities.label: POS Role Limit
entities.name: PosRoleLimit

entities.description: Stock a till sold while it was offline beyond what the warehouse held when the sale arrived. The sale stands (the customer paid and took the goods); the difference waits here until someone counts, moves stock in or writes it off, and says so.
entities.label: Stock Shortfall
entities.name: PosStockShortfall

entities.description: How the workspace's documents print: paper, margins, letter head, drafts and cancelled records, copies.
entities.label: Print Settings
entities.name: PrintSettings

entities.description: The priority an impact and an urgency give, and the response and resolution times of that priority, as ISO 8601 durations (PT30M, PT4H, P2D) counted as working time on the calendar itsm_hours (Admin, Calendars): PT24H is 24 working hours.
entities.label: Priority Matrix Row
entities.name: PriorityMatrix

entities.description: The cause behind incidents, which link to it. Marked a known error with its workaround, and the workaround marked visible, it is published to the service desk's search and to the portal's suggestions. Resolved, it says its root cause and resolves the incidents still open under it, or offers to.
entities.label: Problem
entities.name: Problem

entities.description: What may be quoted together: an item that needs another on the same quotation, two that exclude each other, or one that needs so many of another per unit. A quotation that breaks one lists it, and is not submitted until it is put right.
entities.label: Product Rule
entities.name: ProductRule

entities.description: Plans production from sales orders, material requests or by hand, then makes the work orders and the material requests.
entities.label: Production Plan
entities.name: ProductionPlan

entities.description: What Projects knows of a person who records time: their manager (who approves their time where the workspace says so) and the hours they are expected to record a week (who is reminded).
entities.label: Person
entities.name: ProjectPerson

entities.description: Kinds of project, each with the task workflow its projects use unless a project names its own.
entities.label: Project Type
entities.name: ProjectType

entities.description: Who approves timesheets (where the workspace asks for approval before a timesheet is submitted), and when people short of their week's hours are reminded.
entities.label: Projects Settings
entities.name: ProjectsSettings

entities.description: A discount over a whole sale: when it applies, what it gives and how it combines. Each line's pricing rules come first; promotions then go by priority on what is left
entities.label: Promotion
entities.name: Promotion

entities.description: A code that opens a promotion: one shared code, or many unique ones, each with its own limit
entities.label: Promotion Code
entities.name: PromotionCode

entities.description: An organization being pursued through one or more leads and opportunities.
entities.label: Prospect
entities.name: Prospect

entities.description: The value bands a purchase order's approval reads, in company currency: above each, its step must approve before the order is submitted
entities.label: Purchase Approval Settings
entities.name: PurchaseApprovalSettings

entities.description: A quotation past these limits needs someone else's approval before it can be submitted.
entities.label: Quotation Approval Rule
entities.name: QuotationApprovalRule

entities.description: Hourly billing and costing rates for some time: what a rule names (project, customer, role on the project, person, activity) must match, and the day must fall within its dates. The rule naming a project wins, then one naming a customer, a role, a person, an activity, in that order; among equals the latest start. A rate left empty falls to the next rule, then to the person's activity cost, then to the activity type.
entities.label: Rate Card
entities.name: RateCard

entities.description: A kind of deal or lead: it picks the deal's pipeline, fills in what is left empty when one is made, and asks for fields before it enters a stage (a deal) or a status (a lead). Choose it on the deal or the lead.
entities.label: Record Type
entities.name: RecordType

entities.description: How one item relates to another, read from the item that lists it (Orders runs on Server 1). The impact route follows a relation only if its type says where a failure flows: To the Item (what depends on or runs on another is hit when that one fails), To the Target (a part is part of something that fails with it), or None.
entities.label: Relation Type
entities.name: RelationType

entities.description: A saved report builder view over one entity — a record table, a grouped summary, a pivot or a chart.
entities.label: Report
entities.name: Report

entities.description: One step of fulfilling a catalog request, for a group, made from the offering's steps once the request is approved. The request is fulfilled when its tasks are done.
entities.label: Request Task
entities.name: RequestTask

entities.description: Who is planned onto a project, when, and for how many hours a day. Over-allocation is reported, not refused: planners often know better.
entities.label: Resource Allocation
entities.name: ResourceAllocation

entities.description: Why goods come back or a payment is sent back. The person asking for a refund picks one.
entities.label: Return Reason
entities.name: ReturnReason

entities.description: A shopper asks to send goods back (from the link in their order confirmation, within the store's window). The desk approves or declines; once the goods are in, Receive Goods makes the refund, which credits the invoice and goes back to the payment or as store credit.
entities.label: Return Request
entities.name: ReturnRequest

entities.description: A question asked of every change. Each answer scores; the scores of the questions that measure risk add up to the change's risk, those that measure impact to its impact, against the thresholds in the IT Services settings.
entities.label: Risk Question
entities.name: RiskQuestion

entities.description: Operations in sequence, with the workstation and time each takes.
entities.label: Routing
entities.name: Routing

entities.description: A sales process with its own stages, such as New Business or Renewals. A deal is in one pipeline; one pipeline is the default.
entities.label: Pipeline
entities.name: SalesPipeline

entities.description: Steps of a pipeline with the win probability its deals default to, and what a deal must have before it enters one.
entities.label: Sales Stage
entities.name: SalesStage

entities.description: What a person or a team should win in a month, a quarter or a year: an amount in the company's currency, or a number of deals, in every pipeline or one. A team's achievement is its members'.
entities.label: Sales Target
entities.name: SalesTarget

entities.description: A manager and the people they lead. A person can be in more than one team; their leads, deals, quotations and activities are their first team's unless another of theirs is chosen, and the manager sees and works them.
entities.label: Sales Team
entities.name: SalesTeam

entities.description: A reply written once, inserted from a ticket's composer. The workspace's own merge fields are filled in from the ticket by the action Fill In for a Ticket: {{customer.first_name}}, {{customer.name}}, {{customer.company}}, {{ticket.number}}, {{ticket.subject}}, {{ticket.priority}}, {{ticket.status}}, {{ticket.link}}, {{agent.first_name}} and {{agent.name}}. A field that does not exist is left empty.
entities.label: Saved Reply
entities.name: SavedReply

entities.description: Timed steps for a lead or a contact: send a message from a template, give its owner a task or a call, wait working days. A person is in a sequence once, and it stops when they reply, book a meeting, are converted or closed, ask not to be mailed, or their owner stops it.
entities.label: Sequence
entities.name: Sequence

entities.description: One person in one sequence: where they are, when the next step is due, and why it stopped. Made by Enrol in Sequence on a lead or a contact (on a selection of a list too), or by an automation that creates one.
entities.label: Sequence Enrolment
entities.name: SequenceEnrolment

entities.description: Response and resolution targets per priority, counted in working time on the agreement's own calendar, else on helpdesk_hours (Admin, Calendars: hours, time zone with daylight saving, dated exceptions). The most specific enabled agreement applies: customer, then customer group (nearest), then team and ticket type, then the default one without criteria. A customer's support contract can name one that applies whatever else would.
entities.label: Service Level Agreement
entities.name: ServiceLevelAgreement

entities.description: Something people may ask IT for, with how long it takes and whether it needs approval.
entities.label: Service Offering
entities.name: ServiceOffering

entities.description: A module home page — shortcuts with live counts, link cards, charts, number cards, recent records, notes and onboarding steps.
entities.label: Space
entities.name: Space

entities.description: A shopper asked to be told when an out of stock item is back: told once, when it is.
entities.label: Stock Alert
entities.name: StockAlert

entities.description: One gift card, store credit or package. Its code is kept only as a hash and its last four characters; its balance is the sum of its own ledger, which the statement report shows.
entities.label: Stored Value Account
entities.name: StoredValueAccount

entities.description: A kind of stored value a company issues, such as a gift card, store credit or a prepaid package: what it holds, the liability it sits in, and what may be done with it.
entities.label: Stored Value Kind
entities.name: StoredValueKind

entities.description: A language's words for the storefront's pages and cart, checkout and order screens, over the English the app ships: one record a language, a JSON object of word to text, as assets/words/en.json lists them (each {place} a word fills is kept). A word left out is the English one. The language must be one of Store Settings' Languages Offered.
entities.label: Storefront Words
entities.name: StorefrontWords

entities.description: What a subcontractor makes, from which BOM's materials, and the service item it bills.
entities.label: Subcontracting BOM
entities.name: SubcontractingBom

entities.description: Goods a subcontractor makes from materials we send; the service is bought on a linked purchase order.
entities.label: Subcontracting Order
entities.name: SubcontractingOrder

entities.description: Goods received from a subcontractor, valued at the materials it consumed plus its service and any additional costs.
entities.label: Subcontracting Receipt
entities.name: SubcontractingReceipt

entities.description: Bills a customer once per period for its plans - trial, billing anchor, proration on plan changes, cancellation at period end or at once with credit.
entities.label: Subscription
entities.name: Subscription

entities.description: What a subscription bills each period - an item at a price per billing interval.
entities.label: Subscription Plan
entities.name: SubscriptionPlan

entities.description: An address customers write to: support@ for everyone, or one per team or brand. Mail the Mail app receives for it becomes a new ticket of its team, or a message on the ticket it answers.
entities.label: Support Address
entities.name: SupportAddress

entities.description: What a customer knows a support address by: a name, the words that end every public reply sent under it, and what goes before and after the reply. A support address names its brand; replies to its tickets carry them.
entities.label: Brand
entities.name: SupportBrand

entities.description: What a customer is entitled to: a period, optionally an agreement that applies whatever else would, and optionally a number of tickets.
entities.label: Support Contract
entities.name: SupportContract

entities.description: Several changes to a ticket in one click: set fields, add or remove a tag, send a reply, change the status. Steps run in order and either all apply or none does.
entities.label: Macro
entities.name: SupportMacro

entities.description: Agents who share a ticket queue. Restrict an agent to their teams' tickets with a Support Team scope on the user.
entities.label: Support Team
entities.name: SupportTeam

entities.description: Puts a tag on every ticket the condition holds for, when the ticket is saved; never takes one off.
entities.label: Tag Rule
entities.name: TagRule
